test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 12 Oct 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: A girl spend 76% of her income. If her income increase by 18% and her expenditure increases by 25%, then what is the percentage increase or decrease in her savings (correct to one decimal place)?
solution:
**Given:**

A girl spend her income = 76%

Her income increase = 18%

Her expenditure increases = 25%

**Calculation:**

Let the income of the woman be Rs. 100

Expenditure of woman =(76% of 100)

⇒ (76/100 × 100)

⇒ 76

Saving = (100 – 76) = 24

When income increased by 18%

New income of the woman = 100 + 18% of 100

⇒ (100 + 18/100 × 100) = 118

When expenditure increased by 25%

New expenditure of the woman = 76 + 25% of 76

⇒ (76 + 25/100 × 76)

⇒ (76 + 1/4 × 76)

⇒ (76 + 19)

⇒ 95

New saving = (118 – 95)

⇒ 23

Saving decreases = (24 – 23) = 1

Percentage decreases = (1/24 × 100)

⇒ 25/6

⇒ 4.166% ~ 4.2%

**∴ The savings are decreased by 4.2%**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__**

Let the Total Salary be 100

She Spends 76% of salary = 0.76 × 100 = 76

She saves her salary = 100 - 76 = 24

Salary is increased by 18% = 100 + 18%(100) = 118

Expenditure increases by 25% = 76 + 25%(76) = 95

Savings = (118 - 95) = 23

Percentage of Savings = (24 -23)/(24) × 100 = 4.16

∴ The savings are decreased by 4.2%
